content.text: In Kenya, where conventional payment gateways are restricted, [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/digital-product-stores-kyc-payments-what-actually-how-2|COREMERCH guide to digital]] creators face a formidable challenge: how to sell their products internationally without breaking the bank or sacrificing control. For one creator, the solution came in the form of a sovereign digital commerce stack, which enabled them to go from zero to live in a mere 48 hours. With a stack that leverages [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-workers-crypto-payment-webhooks-explained-digital-creators-7|Cloudflare Workers]] infrastructure, NOWPayments, and [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-supabase-order-database-digital-stores-works-how-5|supabase]], this creator was able to reach a global audience and collect payments in cryptocurrencies like USDT, which settles in under 60 seconds for a fee under $0.10.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: Selling Digital Products from Africa: The Complete Infrastructure Guide at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-digital-products-africa-step-step-deployment-guide. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: The Situation Before the Stack

Before deploying the sovereign digital commerce stack, this Kenyan creator was struggling to sell their digital products to international buyers due to restrictions on conventional payment gateways. The creator's products, ranging from ebooks to software, were stuck in limbo, unable to reach a global audience. The creator's main concern was finding a reliable and cost-effective solution to collect international payments without sacrificing control over their business.
Why Conventional Options Had Already Failed

Conventional payment gateways like Stripe and PayPal were ruled out due to strict regulations and high fees. The creator had already tried Binance P2P, which supports naira, cedis, and Kenyan shillings, but it lacked the scalability and automation needed for international sales. The creator was on the brink of giving up, but then discovered the sovereign digital commerce stack, which promised to revolutionize the way they collected international payments.
The Infrastructure That Was Deployed

The sovereign digital commerce stack was deployed in a mere 48 hours, thanks to the creator's choice of Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, Supabase for order storage, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. This stack enabled the creator to reach a global audience and collect payments in various cryptocurrencies, including USDT, which settles in under 60 seconds for a fee under $0.10.
With a sovereign digital commerce stack, you can collect international payments using cryptocurrencies like USDT, which settles in under 60 seconds for a fee under $0.10.
What Happened After Going Live

Creators in Ethiopia, Cameroon, Tanzania, Venezuela, Zimbabwe, and the Philippines face a compounded challenge: not only are conventional payment platforms unavailable, but local banking infrastructure may add additional friction to receiving international transfers through alternative channels. Crypto payments remove this layer entirely. A seller in Addis Ababa and a seller in Amsterdam receive USDT transactions through the same NOWPayments infrastructure, at the same speed, with the same 0.5% fee. The blockchain has no knowledge of which country a wallet is located in. The webhook fires to both backends identically. Geographic neutrality is not a feature — it is the fundamental property of how blockchains work.
The Lessons That Apply to Your Situation

The Edge Commerce Stack that COREMERCH deploys most frequently combines Cloudflare Pages for storefront hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend webhook handling and order processing, Supabase for order storage, Resend for transactional email delivery, and NOWPayments for crypto payment verification. The total monthly cost is zero. The scale ceiling is significantly higher than what most individual creators need — Cloudflare Workers handles 100,000 requests per day on the free tier, Supabase provides 500MB of PostgreSQL storage, and Resend delivers 3,000 emails per month. For a creator in any country on earth, this stack provides the same infrastructure as a well-funded e-commerce operation at no monthly cost.
How can creators in Africa sell digital products to international buyers?

Global access through sovereign infrastructure works because every layer of the stack is geography-neutral by design. Cloudflare Pages serves your storefront from data centers close to your buyer — whether they are in London or Lagos, the page loads in under 200 milliseconds. NOWPayments generates a unique payment address for each transaction — the buyer sends crypto from any wallet, anywhere in the world. The blockchain confirms the transaction regardless of which country the sender is in. Your Cloudflare Worker receives the webhook and processes the order using the same logic for every buyer.
Conventional payment gateways like Stripe and PayPal are not compatible with a sovereign digital commerce stack.

If you're looking for a more comprehensive solution, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which contains all 6 blueprints and 7 templates needed to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack. You can purchase this kit at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Open a self-custody wallet — Trust Wallet or MetaMask — and back up the seed phrase before configuring anything else. Create your NOWPayments account and configure the self-custody wallet addresses as your payout destination. Open a Binance account and complete enough P2P setup to verify you can convert USDT to your local currency. Deploy your stack and configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint. Build your product pages with USD prices and confirm the checkout generates QR codes and live price feeds correctly. Run a mainnet test transaction from a second wallet to confirm the full pipeline. Do a test P2P conversion with a small amount of USDT to confirm the conversion process works end-to-end. Promote your store.
